## u4b power 

- lower power 9 mW transmit

should need 3.3V to work. 

There's some evidence that the current draw (from google ai) is 40 mA. This works out to 132 mW, which seems high.

u4b max voltage is 6.0V, but max recommended voltage is 5.5V.
circuit operating voltage is 3.3V.
RT9013-3.3 is the Part regulator on board. It's 3.3V out, with maximum 0.4 drop, so minimum input is 3.7V to guarantee turn on.
